messages:
lumen_poc_contact: FYI during the POC demo the Node EventSource polyfill kept throwing 'Unexpected end of JSON input'. We see partial SSE event then the socket closes. ~1-2x / min after a few KB streamed.

maria_sales: Thanks. Hosted or Dedicated? Region?

lumen_poc_contact: Hosted, eu-west. No X-Request-Id present in responses. Also observed occasional 429s just before disconnect.

dan_engineer: Can you share a minimal curl capture and the exact client error?

lumen_poc_contact: curl snippet:
```
GET /v1/streams/abc HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Accept: text/event-stream

< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< Content-Type: text/event-stream
< Transfer-Encoding: chunked
{ [partial chunk]
```
Then body like `data:{"id":42,"text":"partial event` then socket close. Client stack shows JSON.parse failing.

opal_infra: Our proxy logs show `upstream_write() returned 0` and then `502 while reading upstream` around those times. That implies the upstream worker closed unexpectedly or the proxy reset the connection. Two quick suspects: (1) proxy buffering/idle timeout; (2) upstream throttling/token-bucket causing abrupt RST.

kevin_support: Short-term mitigations we can apply on hosted side: turn off proxy_buffering for the route and increase proxy_read_timeout/send_timeout for the org, and ensure `X-Accel-Buffering off`. Also recommend client-side fixes: buffer until full SSE terminator (\n\n) before JSON.parse and add exponential reconnect on abrupt close/429.

dan_engineer: Also our runtime heartbeat is 30s by default. If the proxy idle timeout < 30s it may close. We can add an opt-in 15s heartbeat to keep connections alive. I'll open an internal ticket.

maria_sales: Can infra do a quick canary for that org in eu-west while we triage? Customer needs a stable demo.

opal_infra: On it. Pushing canary: `proxy_buffering off; proxy_read_timeout 180s; send_timeout 180s;` for org lumen-poc in eu-west.

[~5m later]

opal_infra: Canary rolled out. Please retest and give a repro window if it still fails.

lumen_poc_contact: Immediate retest: 0/8 failures (was ~3/8). We'll run a 2hr soak and report back. Thanks for the quick change.

kevin_support: Follow-ups/ACTIONS:
- infra: keep canary for 48h and collect 502/5xx metrics for lumen org
- eng: ticket to add `X-Request-Id` to streaming responses and opt-in 15s heartbeat
- solutions: send a short polyfill snippet showing how to assemble SSE chunks until terminator and reconnect logic

opsbot: Created ticket SF-5112 linking org lumen-poc and this thread.

lumen_poc_contact: Appreciate the fast help :thumbsup:. Will update after the soak.
